about.title: About Promos 2004
paragraphs: Promos 2004 gathers the 45 promo cards from 18 products released in 2004: Yu-Gi-Oh! Capsule Monster Coliseum promotional cards, Yu-Gi-Oh! Destiny Board Traveler promotional cards, Duelist League Series 6 participation card, Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dawn of Destiny promotional cards, Yu-Gi-Oh! Trading Card Game Tour 2004 promotional card, Kids WB Duel of Destiny promotional card, Hobby League 1 participation cards A, Hobby League 1 participation cards B, Invasion of Chaos: Special Edition, Swedish Shonen Jump 2004, Issue 2 promotional card, Shonen Jump Vol. 2, Issue 1 promotional card, Movie Pack, Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos: Joey the Passion promotional cards, Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos: Kaiba the Revenge promotional cards, Yu-Gi-Oh! Reshef of Destruction promotional cards, Shonen Jump Championship 2004 Prize Card, Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship Tournament 2004 promotional cards and Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2004 prize cards.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 45 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 47, adding the 2 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
